title: App Content Card
description: Schema for any app-content card produced by Vyasa lanes (notes, tricks, misconceptions, dpp_tests, grading_feedback, revision, mnemonics, career, parent_copy).

diagram_url.description: M4 addition. Optional reference to an illustrator-produced SVG / PNG diagram. Vyasa is text-only; this field lets downstream consumers attach a diagram to a card without re-issuing it. Format: absolute URL OR repo-relative path like 'content/diagrams/bio/cell_membrane.svg'.

diagram_caption.description: M4 addition. Caption to display alongside diagram_url. Useful when the body text references the diagram but doesn't repeat the caption.

explanation_style.description: M4 addition. When this card was produced under an A/B variant generation, records which style was used. Empty / missing = single canonical version.
